AutoDamage.Name: Roll damage automatically
AutoDamage.Hint: For attacks rolled from an item card. On hit: at least one target must be hit.

AutoSaveDamage.Name: Roll save damage automatically
AutoSaveDamage.Hint: For save activities, such as Fireball. Off: roll it with the Damage button once the saves are made, so no one weighs the damage before saving.

UseChoices.Name: Keep the item use dialog for choices
UseChoices.Hint: While item use skips its dialog, still show it when there is something to choose: the spell slot of a leveled spell or of a feature like Divine Smite, how much of a resource to spend (Lay on Hands), or a facility order.

FastForward.Name: Fast-forward rolls
FastForward.Label: Configure
FastForward.MenuHint: Choose which rolls skip their dialog.
FastForward.Hint: Checked rolls skip their dialog. Hold {key} to show it.
